text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High error rate on /v1/generate in us-west-2: gpu-pool-5. 42 container restarts in last 10m. Root cause signal: GPU OOM during prefill (large-context requests). Auto-escalation: paging eng-runtime-oncall and infra-oncall.
maria: ack. I'm oncall SRE, grabbing logs. seeing repeated `prefill: allocate failed` in container logs for model rwd-70b-ctx. Containers are restarting with SIGKILL.
aj: @maria on eng-runtime here, looking at serving runtime traces. Prefill window spiked to 1.2M tokens in last 5m due to runaway client loop; our prefill allocator tries to reserve > GPU mem.
kevin: infra-oncall — I see NVML Xid 79 / ECC errors on node gpu-07, kernel driver messages about TDR-like hangs. Node shows 3 containers in CrashLoopBackOff.
jen: support-ops: getting customer reports — ACME (prod) and beta-corp seeing 502s and increased latencies. ACME reports failures for long-document ingestion.
maria: mitigation plan attempt 1: throttle dangerous routes and apply immediate policy to trim prefill lengths. Can we push a config to rwd-70b-ctx to set max_prefill_tokens=8192 and enable prefill_trim=true?
aj: we can patch the model config in runtime configstore. I'll open emergency canary to 5% traffic for that model and also add fallback to smaller variant rwd-7b-ctx for requests that exceed 8k tokens.
kevin: while canary runs, I'll cordon gpu-07 and drain it to prevent noisy neighbor restarts. If kernel shows repeated Xid 79, we'll isolate the host.
maria: commands I'll run (kubectl apply):

```bash
kubectl -n inference patch cm runtime-config --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/models/rwd-70b-ctx/max_prefill_tokens","value":8192},{"op":"replace","path":"/models/rwd-70b-ctx/prefill_trim","value":true}]'
# then restart controller to pick up change
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/runtime-controller
```

aj: doing the config patch now, will verify canary routing.
incident-bot: Change publihed to configstore by aj at 7480001310. Canary route 5% applied to model rwd-70b-ctx.
maria: confirming immediate effect — memory pressure on gpu-pool-5 decreased by ~40% on avg. Container restarts dropping.
jen: customer update draft: "We detected GPU memory pressure caused by very long context requests; we applied mitigations to trim extremely long requests and route oversized requests to a fallback model. Some requests may experience degraded output length. We're monitoring and will follow up." Approve?
sam: +1. Keep messaging conservative — call it "large-context requests" not "bug in customer code."
liz: forwarding to ACME CSM. They care about SLA impact and whether data was exposed — confirm no data exfiltration.
kevin: cordon/drain completed for gpu-07 at 7480001550. No further Xid 79s after cordon, but we'll keep it offline for deeper hardware triage.
aj: canary looks clean at 15m. Increasing to 25% to soak. Observed 502s drop to baseline for rwd-70b-ctx. Fallback path hit ~0.7% of requests.
maria: starting postmortem timeline capture. Root cause hypothesis: a client loop sent concatenated documents (no streaming chunking) leading to extremely long prefill sequences, allocator overcommitted memory and killed containers. Secondary factor: one degraded host (gpu-07) with a driver-level instability amplified restarts.
jen: CS asked for ETA to full remediation — do we plan to rollback the canary or keep policy in place?
aj: leave policy for now (max_prefill_tokens=8192, prefill_trim=true) until we cut a runtime patch for more robust prefill allocation accounting and an early reject for >32k tokens. Target patch in 24h.
sam: escalate to eng-runtime(owners) for production fix: add pre-alloc guards and better graceful fallback to CPU or smaller model without restart. Assign to @aj and @kevin for triage + next steps.
maria: handing off active incident to morning SRE rotation. Handoff notes: mitigation applied, canary stable, gpu-07 drained for hardware triage. Monitor for 2h then close incident if stable.
aj: taking on follow-up to own the runtime fix. I'll create an RFC + ticket.
jen: I'll send the customer update and include timeline and mitigations.
liz: ACME acknowledged — wants post-incident call. Scheduling for tomorrow.
incident-bot: Incident status changed to INVESTIGATING -> MITIGATED at 7480004834 by maria. Oncall handoff: maria -> morning-sre.
maria: final note: add a guard in edge rate-limiter to drop single-request prefill > 32k tokens (hard reject) and add a telemetry alert for prefill allocation > 95% GPU mem per container. We'll include those in the next 48h patch.
aj: noted. Creating tickets: RUNTIME-2241 (prefill guard), INFRA-873 (gpu-07 triage), SRE-1188 (alerting). Closing my loop on this handoff.
sam: thanks team. Great quick mitigation. :thumbsup:
